mapper.select: SELECT a.abnormal_id as id, a.abnormal_type, a.related_no, a.order_id, a.user_id, u.nick_name as user_name, a.abnormal_amount, a.duplicate_count, a.abnormal_reason, a.abnormal_desc, a.status, a.handle_solution, a.handle_remark, a.handle_by, (SELECT seller_id FROM sys_order WHERE order_id = a.order_id) as author_id, DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time, DATE_FORMAT(a.handle_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as handle_time FROM sys_finance_abnormal a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.abnormal_id = #{abnormalId}
mapper.insert:
